<?php

class Solution {
    public function solve() {
        $n = $this->readInt();
        $m = $this->readInt();
        
        if ($m == 1) {
            $this->write($n - 1);
        } else {
            $this->write($n * ($m - 1));
        }
    }
    
    private static $reader;
    private static $writer;
    
    public static function main() {
        self::$reader = fopen("php://stdin", "r");
        self::$writer = fopen("php://stdout", "w");
        
        try {
            (new Solution())->solve();
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            throw $e;
        }
        
        fclose(self::$reader);
        fclose(self::$writer);
    }
    
    private static $currentLineTokens = [];
    
    private static function readAndSplitLine() {
        $line = fgets(self::$reader);
        if ($line === false) return [];
        $line = trim($line);
        if ($line === '') return [];
        return preg_split('/[\s\t]+/', $line, -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
    }
    
    public static function readToken() {
        while (empty(self::$currentLineTokens)) {
            self::$currentLineTokens = self::readAndSplitLine();
        }
        return array_shift(self::$currentLineTokens);
    }
    
    public static function readInt() {
        return (int) self::readToken();
    }
    
    public static function readLong() {
        return (int) self::readToken();
    }
    
    public static function readDouble() {
        return (float) self::readToken();
    }
    
    public static function readIntArray() {
        $tokens = self::readAndSplitLine();
        return array_map('intval', $tokens);
    }
    
    public static function readLongArray() {
        $tokens = self::readAndSplitLine();
        return array_map('intval', $tokens);
    }
    
    public static function readDoubleArray() {
        $tokens = self::readAndSplitLine();
        return array_map('floatval', $tokens);
    }
    
    public static function readIntMatrix($numberOfRows) {
        $matrix = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $numberOfRows; $i++) {
            $matrix[$i] = self::readIntArray();
        }
        return $matrix;
    }
    
    public static function readAndTransposeIntMatrix($numberOfRows) {
        $matrix = self::readIntMatrix($numberOfRows);
        $cols = count($matrix[0]);
        $ret = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $cols; $i++) {
            $ret[$i] = [];
            for ($j = 0; $j < $numberOfRows; $j++) {
                $ret[$i][$j] = $matrix[$j][$i];
            }
        }
        return $ret;
    }
    
    public static function readLines($quantity) {
        $lines = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $quantity; $i++) {
            $line = fgets(self::$reader);
            if ($line === false) break;
            $lines[$i] = trim($line);
        }
        return $lines;
    }
    
    public static function writeArray($array) {
        fwrite(self::$writer, implode(' ', $array) . "\n");
    }
    
    public static function write(...$array) {
        self::writeArray($array);
    }
    
    public static function writeLines($array) {
        foreach ($array as $a) {
            fwrite(self::$writer, $a . "\n");
        }
    }
}

<?php

class Solution
{
    public function solve(): void
    {
        $n = $this->readInt();
        $m = $this->readInt();

        if ($m == 1) {
            $this->write($n - 1);
        } else {
            $this->write(1 * $n * ($m - 1));
        }
    }

    private static $reader;
    private static $writer;

    public static function main(): void
    {
        self::$reader = fopen('php://stdin', 'r');
        self::$writer = fopen('php://stdout', 'w');

        try {
            (new Solution())->solve();
        } catch (Exception $ex) {
            echo $ex;
            exit(1);
        }

        fclose(self::$reader);
        fclose(self::$writer);
    }

    private static $currentLineTokens = [];
    private static $currentLineIndex = 0;

    private static function readAndSplitLine(): array
    {
        $line = fgets(self::$reader);
        if ($line === false) {
            return [];
        }
        $tokens = preg_split('/[\s\t]+/', trim($line), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
        return $tokens ?: [];
    }

    public static function readToken(): string
    {
        while (self::$currentLineIndex >= count(self::$currentLineTokens)) {
            self::$currentLineTokens = self::readAndSplitLine();
            self::$currentLineIndex = 0;
        }
        return self::$currentLineTokens[self::$currentLineIndex++];
    }

    public static function readInt(): int
    {
        return (int)self::readToken();
    }

    public static function readLong(): int
    {
        return (int)self::readToken();
    }

    public static function readDouble(): float
    {
        return (float)self::readToken();
    }

    public static function readIntArray(): array
    {
        $line = fgets(self::$reader);
        $tokens = preg_split('/[\s\t]+/', trim($line), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
        return array_map('intval', $tokens ?: []);
    }

    public static function readLongArray(): array
    {
        $line = fgets(self::$reader);
        $tokens = preg_split('/[\s\t]+/', trim($line), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
        return array_map('intval', $tokens ?: []);
    }

    public static function readDoubleArray(): array
    {
        $line = fgets(self::$reader);
        $tokens = preg_split('/[\s\t]+/', trim($line), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
        return array_map('floatval', $tokens ?: []);
    }

    public static function readIntMatrix(int $numberOfRows): array
    {
        $matrix = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $numberOfRows; $i++) {
            $matrix[] = self::readIntArray();
        }
        return $matrix;
    }

    public static function readAndTransposeIntMatrix(int $numberOfRows): array
    {
        $matrix = self::readIntMatrix($numberOfRows);
        if (empty($matrix)) {
            return [];
        }
        $cols = count($matrix[0]);
        $ret = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $cols; $i++) {
            $ret[$i] = [];
            for ($j = 0; $j < $numberOfRows; $j++) {
                $ret[$i][$j] = $matrix[$j][$i];
            }
        }
        return $ret;
    }

    public static function readLines(int $quantity): array
    {
        $lines = [];
        for ($i = 0; $i < $quantity; $i++) {
            $line = fgets(self::$reader);
            $lines[] = trim($line);
        }
        return $lines;
    }

    public static function writeArray(array $array): void
    {
        fwrite(self::$writer, implode(' ', $array) . PHP_EOL);
    }

    public static function write(...$array): void
    {
        self::writeArray($array);
    }

    public static function writeLines(array $array): void
    {
        foreach ($array as $a) {
            fwrite(self::$writer, $a . PHP_EOL);
        }
    }
}

source_data.prob_desc_description: Pak Chanek has a grid that has $$$N$$$ rows and $$$M$$$ columns. Each row is numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$N$$$ from top to bottom. Each column is numbered from $$$1$$$ to $$$M$$$ from left to right.Each tile in the grid contains a number. The numbers are arranged as follows:   Row $$$1$$$ contains integers from $$$1$$$ to $$$M$$$ from left to right.  Row $$$2$$$ contains integers from $$$M+1$$$ to $$$2 \times M$$$ from left to right.  Row $$$3$$$ contains integers from $$$2 \times M+1$$$ to $$$3 \times M$$$ from left to right.  And so on until row $$$N$$$. A domino is defined as two different tiles in the grid that touch by their sides. A domino is said to be tight if and only if the two numbers in the domino have a difference of exactly $$$1$$$. Count the number of distinct tight dominoes in the grid.Two dominoes are said to be distinct if and only if there exists at least one tile that is in one domino, but not in the other.
source_data.prob_desc_output_spec: An integer representing the number of distinct tight dominoes in the grid.
source_data.prob_desc_input_spec: The only line contains two integers $$$N$$$ and $$$M$$$ ($$$1 \leq N, M \leq 10^9$$$) — the number of rows and columns in the grid.
